newsitem.title: GERMANY: American ups Germany-US air cargo rates 10p.
newsitem.headline: American ups Germany-US air cargo rates 10p.

text.p: American Airlines said it will raise air cargo rates from Germany to the UScgoA by 10 percent from April 15.
American's cargo sales manager Germany, Egon Wedde, said higher demand and limited capacity justified the rates rise.
"Business is very strong at the moment. The German market is booming and Europe is also going well," he told Reuters.
"At present everyone is looking for space and that is an opportunity to adjust the rates to more realistic levels," he added.
Wedde noted: "We are still not making money (on the routes) but we are going towards profits."
The market growth was generated by general demand rather than the recent fall in the value of the deutschmark against the US dollar which made German exports cheaper, he said.
American currently had cargo load factors of 86 percent on its daily flights from Frankfurt to Chicago, Dallas and Miami, he added.
Meanwhile in London, American said it raised ex-UK to U.S. air cargo rates by an average five percent from April 1. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
